|translation='''Title:''' General Tagge.

'''Card text:''' Tagge's forfeit is increased by 1 for each Imperial trooper of any type at the same location.

'''Lore:''' An outstanding tactician who oversees the Death Star's defense operations. A steady leader. A member of the powerful noble House of Tagge, which operates a space-weapons conglomerate.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese game text refers to troopers at the same location; the English specifies troopers present with Tagge at a site. The Japanese lore describes a space-weapons conglomerate, while the English says a corporate conglomerate.
